title: Attach one file per question: file types, panel, size limit and names
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  • A template with fields of several types.
  • Have PDF, image (incl. HEIC), Word, Excel and a video file to hand.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm any question type can hold one file attachment, and the upload control reads 'Attach File' on every field type.
2. Upload from the field's properties panel and confirm the accepted types and the size limit are stated there before uploading (PDF, image incl HEIC, Word, Excel accepted; video not).
3. Confirm the stated size limit (20 MB where the platform upload cap is raised to match in the same release, otherwise 10 MB and the panel says 10 MB).
4. Confirm the always-visible attachment is called the general reference file, on every field type.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Any question type can hold one file attachment.
  • PDF, image, Word and Excel files are accepted, including HEIC; video is not accepted.
  • The author uploads from the field's properties panel, where the accepted file types and the size limit are stated before the upload; the limit is 20 MB where the platform's upload cap is raised to match in the same release, otherwise 10 MB and the panel says 10 MB.
  • The upload control reads "Attach File" on every field type.
  • The always-visible attachment is called the general reference file on every field type; the file inside a follow-up block is not a reference file and carries no such label.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9109 (S11 — Attach a reference file to a question); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S11; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R1: “Any question type will hold one file attachment”
  • S11-R2: “PDF, image, Word and Excel files will be accepted, including HEIC. Video will not be accepted”
  • S11-R3: “The author will upload from the field's properties panel, and the accepted file types and the size limit will be stated there before the upload rather than after a file is rejected. The limit is 20 MB where the platform's own upload cap is raised to match in the same release; where it is not, the limit is 10 MB and the panel says 10 MB. No endpoint enforces either figure today — S11 is new work, so this is the decision rather than a description of what exists”
  • S11-R6: “The upload control will read "Attach File" on every field type”
  • S11-R10: “The always-visible attachment is called the general reference file, on every field type. The file inside a follow-up block is not a reference file and carries no such label (S19-R12)”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
